papers.title: The effect of post-sintering treatments on the fatigue and biological behavior of Ti-6Al-4V ELI parts made by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Department of Industrial Engineering, University of Trento, Trento, Italy. Electronic address: matteo.benedetti@unitn.it

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Industrial Engineering, University of Trento, Trento, Italy. Electronic address: matteo.benedetti@unitn.it

papers.venue: Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials/Journal of mechanical behavior of biomedical materials

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文研究了选区激光熔化制造的Ti-6Al-4V ELI部件后烧结处理对疲劳和生物行为的影响，对生物医用植入物材料表征有参考价值，但未涉及多孔结构与应力遮挡的关系。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not specifically address porous structures or their relationship to stress shielding or stiffness matching, which are core to the user's direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究后烧结处理对SLM Ti-6Al-4V ELI部件疲劳和生物行为的影响
summary_zh.method: 对SLM样品进行不同后烧结处理（如HIP、退火），并进行疲劳测试和生物相容性评估
summary_zh.result: 后烧结处理显著改善疲劳寿命，同时保持良好的生物相容性
summary_zh.validation: 通过疲劳实验和细胞培养实验验证后烧结处理效果

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of post-sintering treatments on the fatigue performance and biological response of Ti-6Al-4V ELI components fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melted Ti-6Al-4V ELI specimens were subjected to various post-sintering treatments (e.g., hot isostatic pressing, annealing) and then evaluated through fatigue testing and in vitro biological assays.
summary_en.result: Post-sintering treatments significantly enhanced fatigue life while maintaining favorable biocompatibility.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed via mechanical fatigue tests and cell culture studies to assess both mechanical and biological outcomes.

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the association between discharge to inpatient facilities and postdischarge morbidity after total hip arthroplasty
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis of patient outcomes comparing discharge destinations using large-scale clinical database

summary_en.validation: Statistical analysis on a large clinical cohort

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how pore size and porosity affect the mechanical and biological performance of porous titanium scaffolds for bone tissue engineering.
summary_en.method: Porous titanium scaffolds with controlled pore sizes and porosities were fabricated and characterized by mechanical compression tests and in vitro cell culture.
summary_en.result: Both pore size and porosity significantly influenced the compressive strength and cell proliferation, with an optimal range identified.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through mechanical testing and in vitro biological assays.

papers.title: An Assessment of Subsurface Residual Stress Analysis in SLM Ti-6Al-4V
papers.abstract: Ti-6Al-4V bridges were additively fabricated by selective laser melting (SLM) under different scanning speed conditions, to compare the effect of process energy density on the residual stress state. Subsurface lattice strain characterization was conducted by means of synchrotron diffraction in energy dispersive mode. High tensile strain gradients were found at the frontal surface for samples in an as-built condition. The geometry of the samples promotes increasing strains towards the pillar of the bridges. We observed that the higher the laser energy density during fabrication, the lower the lattice strains. A relief of lattice strains takes place after heat treatment.

llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure design, stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; it focuses solely on residual stress in SLM Ti-6Al-4V bridges with no biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM Ti-6Al-4V中工艺参数对残余应力的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用同步辐射衍射测量不同扫描速度下试样的亚表层晶格应变。
summary_zh.result: 高激光能量密度导致较低的晶格应变，热处理后应变释放。
summary_zh.validation: 通过同步辐射实验数据验证残余应力分布。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of processing parameters on residual stress in SLM-fabricated Ti-6Al-4V.
summary_en.method: Subsurface lattice strain was characterized using synchrotron diffraction in energy dispersive mode on bridges fabricated under different scanning speeds.
summary_en.result: Higher laser energy density resulted in lower lattice strains, and heat treatment relieved the strains.
summary_en.validation: Experimental synchrotron diffraction data validated the residual stress analysis.

papers.title: The Relationship of Processing Parameters and Surface Topography of Selective Laser Melted GH4169 Alloy
papers.abstract: Selective laser melting (SLM) technology based on powder bed has been used to manufacture GH4169 samples. In the present work, taking Ni-based powders of GH4169 as experiment material, the good technological parameters of SLM were determined by analyzing the effect of the laser electric current, the scan speed ,the laser pulse width, the laser light frequency, the push powder thickness, the scan interval and the scanning way on Single-layer single-channel scanning, single-layer multi-channel scanning and multi-level multi-channel scanning. The effects of process parameters on the powder formability was analyzed. The cross-sections morphology and density of the block specimen prepared under the different SLM process parameter were studied. The optimal process parameters were the scanning speed of 150 mm/min, the laser pulse width of 5.0 ms, the push powder thickness of 0.15 mm, the scanning current of 140 A, the laser light frequency of 12Hz and the scan interval of 0.25mm.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究镍基高温合金GH4169的选区激光熔化工艺参数对表面形貌的影响，未涉及生物医学材料或植入物相关力学性能、疲劳或骨整合。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no stress shielding or stiffness matching, no fatigue testing, no osseointegration, and no LPBF fabrication of biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化GH4169镍基合金的SLM工艺参数以改善成形质量。
summary_zh.method: 通过单道、多道及多层扫描实验分析激光电流、扫描速度等参数的影响。
summary_zh.result: 确定了最佳工艺参数组合，获得了高致密度试样。
summary_zh.validation: 通过截面形貌和密度测量验证工艺参数的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize the selective laser melting process parameters for GH4169 nickel-based superalloy to achieve good formability.
summary_en.method: Single-layer single-channel, single-layer multi-channel, and multi-level multi-channel scanning experiments were conducted to analyze effects of laser current, scan speed, pulse width, and other parameters.
summary_en.result: Optimal process parameters were identified, yielding high-density specimens.
summary_en.validation: Cross-sectional morphology and density measurements confirmed the effectiveness of the optimized parameters.
